claim: The fiscal 2024 Q3 diluted EPS result was around $1.53 at Apple.
summary: Apple's reported fiscal 2024 Q3 (quarter ended June 29, 2024, reported Aug. 1, 2024) diluted EPS was $1.40, not around $1.53. $1.53 was the fiscal 2024 Q2 diluted EPS result, so the Q3 claim is materially inaccurate.

sub_claims.text: Apple's fiscal 2024 Q3 diluted EPS was approximately $1.53
sub_claims.stated_text: The fiscal 2024 Q3 diluted EPS result was around $1.53 at Apple.
sub_claims.note: Without tools, based on parametric knowledge: Apple reported fiscal Q3 2024 diluted EPS of $1.40 (revenue $85.78B). $1.53 corresponds to fiscal Q2 2024 diluted EPS, not Q3. A ~$0.13 / ~9% difference exceeds reasonable 'around' tolerance.

sub_claims.text: The reporting entity is Apple Inc.
sub_claims.note: Claim explicitly names Apple as the entity.
